title: PANKAJ CHAUDHARY versus STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
UKHC010160222026
2026:UHC:8210
HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition Service Single No.2380 of 2026
11th September, 2026
Pankaj Chaudhary ............Petitioner
Versus
State of Uttarakhand and others ..........Respondents
----------------------------------------------------------------------
Presence:-
Mr. Jitendra Chaudhary, learned counsel for the petitioner.
Mr. Anil K. Dabral, learned Addl. C.S.C. with Mr. Shubhr Rastogi,
learned B.H. for the State.
----------------------------------------------------------------------
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
At the outset, learned counsel for petitioner
submits that petitioner does not want to press Relief Clause
No.(a) of the Prayer Clause.
2. Accordingly writ petition is dismissed as not
pressed so far as Relief Clause No.(a) is concerned.
3. Petitioner is working as an Assistant Teacher, L.T.
Grade (Physical Education) in Government Higher Secondary
School, Gudlekh, Syaldey, District-Almora. Since petitioner is
a divorcee he made an application to respondent no.4-
Additioanl Director, Secondary Education, Kumaon Division,
Nainital, under provisions of Section 17(1)(b)(5) of
Uttarakhand Public Servants Annual Transfer Act, 2017
(hereinafter referred to as "Act of 2017") for transferring him
in any one of the schools mentioned in his application dated
18.07.2026. In the said application, petitioner has given ten
options and out of these ten options the post of Assistant
Teacher, L.T. Grade, (Physical Education) is vacant only in
Option No.8 i.e., Government Inter College, Banskhera,
Kashipur, Udham Singh Nagar, therefore he submits that he
should be transferred to that school acting under the
aforesaid provisions of Act of 2017. But unfortunately the
application of the petitioner has not been considered and
1

various transfers have been made by respondent on
27.08.2026 but petitioner has not been transferred. When
application of petitioner has not been considered and he has
not been transferred, petitioner has submitted a
representation to respondent no.4 on 31.08.2026, annexure
no.5 to writ petition, which is still pending disposal. It is
feeling aggrieved, petitioner is before this Court.
4. Learned counsel for petitioner submits that if
respondent no.4 is directed to take a decision on application
as well as representation of petitioner within a stipulated
time, the ends of justice would be met.
5. Learned counsel for State has no objection if such
an order is passed.
6. Accordingly writ petition is finally disposed of.
Respondent no.4 is directed to take a decision immediately on
application dated 18.07.2026 as well as representation dated
31.08.2026 within a period of two weeks' from date of
production of certified copy of this order and pass appropriate
order keeping in view the provisions of Section 17(1)(b)(5) of
Act of 2017 and transfer petitioner in the school mentioned at
Sr. No.8 of options given by him in application dated
18.07.2026, if it is still vacant.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 11.09.2026
